results.content: In active learning, a model is trained on a small amount of data (the initial training set), and an acquisition function (often based on the model’s uncertainty) decides which data points to ask an external oracle for a label. Taking advantage of specialised models such as Bayesian convolutional neural networks (BCNNs) (Gal & Ghahramani, 2016a;b), we demonstrate our active learning techniques with image data.
